score_rationale: Patrick Marais's advanced IT and management experience may offer some theoretical value, but his lack of practical hardware repair skills and customer service background severely undermines his suitability for a hands-on computer repair role.
key_strengths: Advanced IT/Security expertise, extensive management background
key_weaknesses: No practical PC/laptop repair experience, unfamiliar with basic hardware components (RAM, SSD), lack of customer service or patience with older clients
final_evaluation: Despite impressive qualifications, Patrick Marais is significantly overqualified for this part-time, hands-on repair role and lacks the essential practical skills and customer service experience required by the position.
